rationale: The Court will likely hold unanimously that a bare Item 303 omission is not actionable under §10(b)/Rule 10b-5(b) absent a misleading half-truth, relying on the rule’s text and the structural contrast with Securities Act §11’s “required to be stated” language. Any separate writings would mainly emphasize limits on implied private rights and the continued relevance of Item 303 to assessing whether affirmative statements were misleading.
